series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified. All 55 new exercises target an N3 construction and offer only N3 alternatives, so all are jlpt 3; no Rule C labels.

primarySources.use: N3 と言っても: accepts a statement, then limits it; after a plain form or noun, or sentence-initially.
N3 どんなに〜ても 'no matter how': degree or effort, usable for real outcomes.
N3 いくら〜ても／でも 'no matter how much': amount or repetition, usable for real outcomes.
N3 〜ても〜なくても 'whether or not': affirmative and negative of the same word.

primarySources.url: https://bunpro.jp/grammar_points/としたら-とすれば-とすると
primarySources.use: N3 としたら／とすれば／とすると 'assuming that': plain form + ending; three near-equivalent forms.
N3 にしては 'for a …': result measured against a category's expectation.
N3 にしても 'even granting': premise granted, judgement or demand holds; also question word + にしても.
N3 さえ〜ば 'as long as / if only': formation with nouns, verb stems, て-forms and adjectives.
N3 たとえ〜ても 'even if': hypothetical case with ても／でも／としても.
N3 わりに 'considering': result out of proportion to a degree; Noun + の, plain forms, な-adjective + な.
N3 ながらも 'although': neutral or positive concession; ます-stem, adjectives, nouns without の.
N3 できれば／できたら 'if possible': softens the speaker's own wish or request.
N3 Noun + でよければ 'if this will do': modest offer.
N3 もしも〜なら／もしも〜ても: emphatic もし for unlikely suppositions.
N3 くせに 'even though' with reproach; Noun + の, plain verb/adjective forms.
N3 どころか 'far from': rejects A for the opposite or something stronger.

dispositions.entry: としたら-とすれば-とすると
dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (Lesson 5), page inspected 2026-11-17; Sensei and SKM not checked for this set
dispositions.note: The three endings form one construction. All three are accepted when the result is a conclusion drawn from the premise (left-airport, daily-cost, river-rain). On study-abroad-country the result is a question about a preference, where とすると is unnatural, so only としたら and とすれば are accepted. All supposition items share one instruction label, which says that とすると is used only before a conclusion. Every new exercise is jlpt 3: the target and every well-formed option are Bunpro N3 constructions.

groups.reason: ても〜なくても, さえ〜ば and としたら are three roles for one condition clause; they sit beside the existing condition material.
たとえ, いくら, どんなに and もしも announce a concessive or conditional ending, so they follow the conditionals chapter.
と言っても and どころか correct a claim; they extend the contrast connectors.
ながらも and くせに are concessive 'although' patterns next to the existing のに and くせに practice.
にしては, わりに and にしても compare a result with an expectation; they extend the のに／わりに contrast material.
できれば and でよければ soften requests and offers, so they sit with the request material.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.
